syllabus:
On the defendants’ Appeal.

Claimant brought suit in the Court of Claims to recover from the United States the sum of $282.66 for the difference, he alleged, he was entitled to as a passed assistant surgeon in the Navy, with the rank of lieutenant, for mounted pay from December 26, 1900, to July 27, 1901, with 10 per cent increase for service outside the limits of the United States.
summary:
The court below found the facts without an opinion and the claimant was given judgment for $141.33 on the authority of the case of Richardson v. The United States. (38 C. Cls. R,., 182.) The 10 per cent increase was not allowed.-

The judgment of the court below is affirmed on the same grounds.
